title: Housing Board Reviews Mortgage Bonds
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation Board convened to discuss important financial matters on July 20, 1995.
*   A primary agenda item involved a detailed presentation on the status of the 1994 Single Family Mortgage Revenue Refunding Bonds, Series A and B.
*   Samuel Biscoe, President of the Travis County Housing Finance Corporation, provided insights into these critical housing-related bonds.
*   Following the presentation, the Board did not take any immediate policy action or make new decisions regarding the bond status.
